item.title: Other issue with a footway/pavement problem, 11th September
item.description:
The footpath is too small for cyclists and pedestrians to cohabit safely. Especially if you are hard of hearing. Cyclists race up the cycle path and end up nearly hitting pedestrians. I witnessed a near-miss just days ago. This is dangerous and something needs to be done before someone gets hurt. Please please can this be looked at as a priority?
